statement_summary: Program meets the HIPAA Security Rule in both roles and is documented
Security Officer designated in writing
Annual enterprise risk analysis using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; no emergency-response risk accepted above Low
Quarterly audit committee reporting
Annual policy and standard review
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Documented sanctions
No BAA, no PHI, including client PHI and new vendor features
Annual Tier 1 vendor reassessment
Annual independent evaluation
6-year retention of security documentation
AI tools approved through the AI governance gate
Unique accounts; per-vehicle MDC accounts as a time-limited exception
Role-based, approved, least-privilege access; client workspace separation
MFA for all; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators
Same-day disable; all other access within 24 hours
Transfers remove prior access within 5 business days
Quarterly access reviews
Separate privileged accounts; limited CAD administration; just-in-time cloud rights
Lockout, idle lock, session timeout; console equivalent measure
Break-glass accounts for critical systems
14-character passwords; vaulted device credentials; no default passwords
Vendor remote access through the broker, approved and recorded
Mobile devices enrolled, encrypted, and wipeable
Runbooks for CAD ransomware and billing vendor breach
Manual dispatch at once; county outage notice
Report suspected incidents immediately, within 1 hour
Log every incident with discovery time
Crisis management team within 2 hours for severity 1
Breach determination and decision log, including client attribution
Notifications per the P08 matrix, confirmed by counsel
Insurer hotline before vendors
Ransom only with approvals and an OFAC check
Annual runbook exercises; twice-yearly manual dispatch drills
Lessons learned within 30 days; Medical Director review
Four classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Company-managed keys; separate backup keys
Restricted data only in approved systems; client data kept separate
Restricted data and device inventory reconciled quarterly
Sanitize or destroy media with certificates
Isolated, write-once, tested backups
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools
Retention: EMS 5 years, Medicare 7 years, security 6 years, client data per BAA
Company systems for company business; no personal use on consoles, MDCs, tablets
Annual acknowledgment
Annual and role-based training
Lock screens; protect tablets; position screens
No unapproved software or personal devices on operational equipment
Report phishing and incidents
Access only when the job requires; access is reviewed
Approved AI tools only; humans responsible for AI-assisted work
No photos with personal phones
